07683 shagag {shaw-gag'}

字根型; TWOT - 2324; 動詞

欽定本 - err 1, flesh 1, sin ignorantly 1, deceived 1, went astray 1; 5

1) 迷路, 出錯, 犯罪或犯錯
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 犯錯 (精神方面地) （#伯 12:16|）
       1a2) 犯罪 (無知地或因疏忽而造成地)

AV - err 1, flesh 1, sin ignorantly 1, deceived 1, went astray 1; 5
